item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Mindset. Your thoughts shape how the day feels, so treat them as something you can check, not something that just happens to you. When a heavy thought shows up, ask whether it's a fact or a guess. Ask whether you're assuming what others think. Then choose the more useful view. Small pauses make this easier. Action: at midday, stop for one minute and rewrite one negative thought.
